requirement: This code should implement a function to calculate the coordinates of a point after rotation around a specified center. The function, named RotationCalculation, takes five inputs: rCenterX and rCenterY (REAL) specifying the X and Y coordinates of the rotation center, rAngle (REAL) specifying the rotation angle in degrees, and rPointX and rPointY (REAL) specifying the X and Y coordinates of the point to be rotated. The function outputs two REAL values, rRotatedX and rRotatedY, which are the new coordinates of the point after rotation. The rotation is performed by first translating the point to the origin based on the rotation center, applying the rotation matrix using the sine and cosine of the converted angle (from degrees to radians), and then translating the point back to its original position around the center. The function should always return TRUE to indicate successful calculation.
provide_code:
FUNCTION RotationCalculation : BOOL
VAR_INPUT
    rCenterX : REAL;    (* X coordinate of rotation center *)
    rCenterY : REAL;    (* Y coordinate of rotation center *)
    rAngle : REAL;      (* Rotation angle in degrees *)
    rPointX : REAL;     (* X coordinate of point to rotate *)
    rPointY : REAL;     (* Y coordinate of point to rotate *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    rRotatedX : REAL;   (* X coordinate after rotation *)
    rRotatedY : REAL;   (* Y coordinate after rotation *)
END_VAR
requirement_cn: 这段代码应实现一个函数，用于计算绕指定中心旋转后点的坐标。该函数名为RotationCalculation，接受五个输入：rCenterX 和 rCenterY（REAL类型）指定旋转中心的X和Y坐标，rAngle（REAL类型）指定以度为单位的旋转角度，以及rPointX和rPointY（REAL类型）指定要旋转的点的X和Y坐标。函数输出两个REAL类型的值，rRotatedX 和 rRotatedY，这是点旋转后的新坐标。旋转是通过首先将点基于旋转中心平移到原点，使用转换为弧度的角度的正弦和余弦应用旋转矩阵，然后将点围绕中心平移回其原始位置来执行的。函数应始终返回TRUE，以表示计算成功。
